title: Console 17.6.0: the tabbed Edit/New form dialog renders no tab for a `{ group }` form section, and `record:details` edit mode offers no editor for a markdown field — so group-referenced fields and markdown fields have no editing surface
body:
Filing gate: **① product defect with reach measured. Class (a).** reach: public door, the console UI. Two findings measured by a dev run of the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`session_01ER8ntXZhYebyQ66aXWdjfT`) on fresh boots of hotcrm on `@objectstack/*` 17.6.0, in Chromium. The served page and view metadata were checked equal to the compiled artifact. They are filed together because together they leave a field with no editing surface at all.

**Who acts on it:** objectstack triage routes it, likely to objectui as the renderer. ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets type and grade. Per hotcrm AGENTS.md §1, the app does not compensate for it. hotcrm#1950 changed three of its own fields to `Field.textarea` on a maintainer ruling. That was a type choice its requirement allowed, and it is not a fix for these defects.

## 1. The tabbed form dialog drops `{ group }` sections

- hotcrm `src/sales/views/contact.view.ts` declares `form.sections` with `{ group: 'buying_centre', columns: 2 }`, the #13855 / #13897 group-reference form, and the compiled form sections list it.
- **Measured:** Contacts › any contact › More actions › Edit shows the tabs [Identity, Contact Info, Mailing Address, Preferences]. There is **no Buying Centre tab**.
- The same holds for hotcrm PR #1950's opportunity form: its `{ group }` sections render no tab, while the four hand-enumerated sections do (Edit dialog tabs: Overview, Forecast, Sales Strategy, Win / Loss).
- **Control:** `record:details` on the same records renders the same `{ group }` references (the #16695 fix holds). So the spec form is served, and only the form dialog drops it.
- #13897 states "the renderer half is tracked separately" (objectui#7051). That card is not readable from this seat, so whether it covers the **form dialog** as well as `record:details` is unverified. If it does, this item is a duplicate of it.

## 2. `record:details` edit mode has no markdown editor

- **Measured:** Opportunities › any deal › Details › the pencil (edit mode). Select, boolean, date, currency and textarea fields get editors, and their saves read back over REST. Markdown fields (`description`, and on PR #1950 three narrative fields) stay `—`, with an editor count of 0 per markdown cell.
- **Control:** a markdown field that a form names explicitly does get an editor in the Edit dialog (the account Description).
- **Consequence on hotcrm `main` today:** `crm_opportunity.description` (markdown) is in no opportunity form, so it has no UI editing surface at all. Item 1 then also removes the form-dialog route for any markdown field reached through a `{ group }` section.

## Duplicate check

Objectstack issues updated since 2026-07-01, state all: 5,268 issues over 100 REST pages. ⚠️ The walk stopped at the API's page ceiling (page 101 answered 422), so completeness is declared, not proven.
- Title and body were grepped for tab/tabbed near `{ group` / group-ref / fieldGroup: 1 hit, #16695 (closed), which is `record:details` crashing on the group form, a different surface and fixed.
- Title and body were grepped for markdown near editor / inline edit / edit mode / record:details: 2 hits, #19482 (docs authoring) and #1795 (ADR-0048), both other subjects.
- Positive control: `record:details` hit 10.

Dedupe words: tabbed form group section · form.sections group reference no tab · buying_centre tab missing · record:details edit mode markdown · markdown field not editable
